scope: Native GUI Split and current shared GUI/public MCP comparison for one closed convex cutter.

native.command: Edit square-source > Additional tools > Split Mesh
native.mode: Split with another body or a mesh

diagnosis.interpretation: The seam stage splits both incident faces at each of eight constraint midpoints, accounting for 16 added facets. Refined facets still differ from native, so suppressing midpoints alone is insufficient.

regression.status: Native comparison remains an expected failure: 306 application coordinates vs 162 native coordinates.

limitations: One small manufactured source and convex cutter; not proof of general native Split behavior.
STL does not preserve native indexed seam identity; geometric position welding joins seam edges. The native two-component count is a GUI observation, not an inference from the STL.
Native save/reopen, cancellation, preview repeats, other cutters and complete geometry equivalence remain unverified.
No behavioral correction has been made.
